provenance.what: Third live run: the full golden set with hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense, interleaved) enabled.
provenance.models: Chat: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 Q4_K_M via llama-cpp-python, 8,192-token window. Embeddings: nomic-embed-text v1.5 Q4_K_M, 768 dims, task prefixes applied.
provenance.corpus: evals/corpus/aveline minus archive/ - 10 documents across Markdown, Word, Excel and PDF
provenance.golden_set: evals/golden-aveline - 26 cases, 17 answerable, 9 must-refuse, 37 wrong-answer guards
provenance.compared_against: second-live-run.json via eval --baseline; every field matched
provenance.what_it_caught_first: The first hybrid run scored 23.5%: interleaving kept each retriever's own score, and the structural reranker re-sorted the fused list by a mixture of BM25 (2-15) and cosine (0.5-0.8) scales, burying the right chunks. Thirteen answerable questions refused. Fixed by making the fused score 1/position; this run is the same set after the fix.
provenance.retrieval_gain: Separately measured recall@3 on 19 casual/exact/literal questions: BM25 alone 15/19, hybrid interleaved 18/19. Recall is not accuracy; only this golden-set run gates the change.
provenance.added_latency: 69 ms to embed the question; one-time 3.5 s to embed the 59-chunk corpus (cached in vectors.db).
provenance.not_evidence_of: accuracy on real documents - the corpus and questions were written together. It shows the pipeline behaves identically with the dense half on, and better on phrasings BM25 misses.
provenance.reproduce: docs/TEST-RUN.md; serve nomic-embed via llama-cpp-python with --embedding true and set OK_EMBEDDING_*.
